component_readme.name: TECXMLParser
component_readme.summary: TECXMLParser is a Delphi Component to handle xml formatted text or files without msxml. TECXMLParser can currently read most XML documents and supports both embedded name properties and text values for each tag.

version.feature: Added an .AsString property to the TXMLItem type to ease copy/paste and other such actions.
Changed the parser to use a specialized XMLTokenizer for speed.
CrLfInAsString added for single line representation of XML structures when needed.
Support for Paramaters in tag names
Support for text inside of a tag
XML version of Readme file. XML Browser was used to create this document.
The XSL file for this readme was also created and edited in XML Browser. Thanks to e-AllPer for the idea of the layout.
Fully 8859-1 Complient (as far as I know) if you find that it isn't then drop me an e-mail and I'll see if I can fix whatever isn't :)

property.name: Root
property.description: Returns a TXMLItem that represents the entire Document.

property.name: StyleSheet
property.description: If the StyleSheet property is set then when the XML file is saved the XSL header will be automatically generated for you.

property.name: CrLfInAsString
property.description: Returns if the use of the carrage return (#13) and line feed (#10) should be used when AsString and SaveToStream/File are called.

function.name: StrToXML( str : String ) : String;
function.description: Takes a string and turns it into an XML safe string. This function is automatically called when any XML structure is saved, so you shouldn't have to worry about it.

function.name: XMLToStr( XML : String ) : String;
function.description: Takes a XML string and turns it into a normal Delphi string. This function is automatically called when any XML structure is loaded, so you shouldn't have to worry about it.

method.name: LoadFromFile( FileName : String );
method.description: Loads an existing XML file for you to use.

method.name: SaveToFile( FileName : String );
method.description: Saves the current XML structure in memory to a text file.

method.name: LoadFromStream( Stream : TStream );
method.description: Loads an existing XML structure in string format from a stream. Called by LoadFromFile to perform the acutal load.

method.name: SaveToStream( Stream : TStream );
method.description: Saves the XML structure in string format to a stream. Called by SaveToFile to perform the acutal save.

event.name: XMLItemChanged
event.description: When a TXMLItem changes it calls this even to let you know. See the XML Browser demo to see more about how this works.

event.name: OnLoaded
event.description: This event fires when you call TECXMLParser.LoadFromFile or TECXMLParser.LoadFromStream method.

event.name: OnCleared
event.description: This event fires when you call TECXMLParser.Clear.

event.name: OnSaved
event.description: This event fires when you call TECXMLParser.SaveToFile or TECXMLParser.SaveToStream.

event.name: BeforeLoad
event.description: This event fires before the actual load happens when you call TECXMLParser.LoadFromFile or TECXMLParser.LoadFromStream. Setting Allow to false will stop the load process.

event.name: BeforeSave
event.description: This event fires before the actual save happens when you call TECXMLParser.SaveToFile or TECXMLParser.SaveToStream. Setting Allow to false will stop the save process.

event.name: BeforeClear
event.description: This event fires before the actual clear happens when you call TECXMLParser.Clear. Setting Allow to false will stop the clear process.
